shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo "---" && cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null

rg -n "export declare function after" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/after.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg -rn "function after" /workspace/node_modules/next/types/ /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

rg -rn "after" /workspace/node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---grep after in dist---"; rg -rln "declare function after\|export.*after\b" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---find after files---"; find /workspace/node_modules/next -name "*.d.ts" | xargs rg -l "function after" 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace; node -e "const s=require('next/server'); console.log('after' in s ? 'has after' : 'NO after'); console.log(Object.keys(s).filter(k=>/after|revalidat|unstable_cache/i.test(k)))" 2>&1 | head; echo "---"; rg -n "after" /workspace/node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace; find node_modules/next -name "*.d.ts" -exec grep -l "function after" {} \; 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== search next/server.d.ts path ==="; node -e "console.log(require.resolve('next/server'))" 2>&1

cd /workspace; find node_modules/next -name "server.d.ts" -path "*server*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== resolve types ==="; node -e "console.log(require.resolve('next/server', {paths:[process.cwd()]}))"; ls node_modules/next/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace; grep -n "after" node_modules/next/server.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/api/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /workspace; find node_modules/next/dist/server/after -type f | head; echo "=== after index ==="; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/after.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== if dir ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/after/ 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/after/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace; cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== revalidateTag sig ==="; rg -n "revalidateTag" node_modules/next/dist/ -g "*.d.ts" | head
cd /workspace; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.js 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after-context.js 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace; sed -n '120,260p' node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/unstable-cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60
cd /workspace; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/next/dist/server/revalidation-utils.js 2>/dev/null | grep -n "withExecuteRevalidates\|pendingRevalidatedTags\|executeRevalidates\|function " | head -40
cd /workspace; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== tsc exit: $? ==="
cd /workspace; timeout 180 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -50; echo "=== build exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="

cd /workspace; (PORT=3100 npm run start >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; echo "=== server log ==="; cat /tmp/next-start.log; echo "=== GET / (first) ==="; curl -s localhost:3100/ -o /tmp/page1.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; echo "=== lastSynced / prices in page1 ==="; grep -o "Last synced: [^<]*" /tmp/page1.html | head -1; grep -oE '\$[0-9]+' /tmp/page1.html | head -6

cd /workspace; echo "=== Last synced line ==="; grep -o "Last synced:[^<]*<" /tmp/page1.html | head; echo; echo "=== prices (td) ==="; grep -oE '>\$[0-9]+<' /tmp/page1.html | head; echo; echo "=== table rows sample ==="; python3 -c "import re;h=open('/tmp/page1.html').read();m=re.search(r'',h,re.S);print(m.group(0)[:1200] if m else 'no table')" 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== action references ==="; grep -oE 'action="[^"]*"' /tmp/page1.html | head; grep -oE '\$F[0-9a-f]+' /tmp/page1.html | head; grep -oE 'next-action[^"]*"[^"]*"' /tmp/page1.html | head

cd /workspace; echo "=== rendered 'Last synced' text ==="; python3 -c " import re h=open('/tmp/page1.html').read() m=re.search(r'Last synced:.*?

',h,re.S) print(repr(m.group(0)[:200]) if m else 'not found') "; echo; echo "=== search for action id patterns ==="; grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{40}' /tmp/page1.html | sort -u | head; echo "=== hd reference context ==="; python3 -c " import re h=open('/tmp/page1.html').read() for m in re.finditer(r'\"\$hd\"', h): s=max(0,m.start()-5); print('...'+h[s:m.start()+60]+'...') " | head

cd /workspace; AID="00be8bddc2c1e2f876845211cf681893cc847619"; echo "=== POST action (timed) ==="; curl -s localhost:3100/ -X POST -H "Next-Action: $AID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data-binary '[]' -o /tmp/action_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} time_total=%{time_total}s\n"; echo "=== action response (head) ==="; head -c 400 /tmp/action_resp.txt; echo; echo "=== wait 4.5s for background sync + revalidate ==="; sleep 4.5; echo "=== GET / after sync ==="; curl -s localhost:3100/ -o /tmp/page2.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; python3 -c " import re h=open('/tmp/page2.html').read() m=re.search(r'Last synced:.*?

',h,re.S); print('lastSynced:', repr(m.group(0)[:160]) if m else 'NA') for p in ['Laptop','Phone','Tablet']: m=re.search(re.escape(p)+r']*>\\\$(\d+)', h); print(p, '->', m.group(1) if m else 'NA') "

cd /workspace; python3 -c "
import re
h=open('/tmp/page1.html').read()
# find all __next_f.push chunks
chunks=re.findall(r'self\.__next_f\.push\(\[1,\"(.*?)\"\]\)', h, re.S)
print('num chunks:', len(chunks))
full=''.join(chunks)
# find context around \$hd and any long tokens that look like action ids
for m in re.finditer(r'hd', full):
    s=max(0,m.start()-40); print('HDCTX:', repr(full[s:m.start()+40]))
" 2>&1 | head -30
echo "=== look for action-id-like long strings in full html ==="
grep -oE '[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{32,}' /tmp/page1.html | grep -vE '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' | sort -u | head -20

cd /workspace; AID="00be8bddc2c1e2f876845211cf681893cc84761979"; echo "=== POST action (timed) ==="; curl -s localhost:3100/ -X POST -H "Next-Action: $AID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data-binary '[]' -o /tmp/action_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code}  time_total=%{time_total}s\n"; echo "=== action response (head) ==="; head -c 500 /tmp/action_resp.txt; echo

cd /workspace; echo "waiting 5s for background sync (3s) + revalidateTag..."; sleep 5; echo "=== GET / after sync ==="; curl -s localhost:3100/ -o /tmp/page2.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; python3 -c " import re h=open('/tmp/page2.html').read() m=re.search(r'Last synced:.*?

',h,re.S); print('lastSynced:', re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',m.group(0)) if m else 'NA') for p in ['Laptop','Phone','Tablet','Headphones','Watch']: m=re.search(re.escape(p)+r']*>\\\$(\d+)', h); print(f' {p:>10} -> \${m.group(1)}' if m else f' {p:>10} -> NA') print('--- compare to initial: 999/699/499/199/299 ---') "

cd /workspace; AID="00be8bddc2c1e2f876845211cf681893cc84761979"; echo "=== rapid double GET (cache proof) ==="; curl -s localhost:3100/ -o /tmp/a.html; curl -s localhost:3100/ -o /tmp/b.html; python3 -c " import re def ls(f): h=open(f).read(); m=re.search(r'Last synced:.*?

',h,re.S); return re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',m.group(0)) if m else 'NA' print('GET1:',ls('/tmp/a.html')); print('GET2:',ls('/tmp/b.html')); print('identical:', open('/tmp/a.html').read()==open('/tmp/b.html').read()) "; echo "=== trigger second sync ==="; curl -s localhost:3100/ -X POST -H "Next-Action: $AID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data-binary '[]' -w "action HTTP %{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" -o /dev/null; sleep 5; echo "=== GET / after second sync ==="; curl -s localhost:3100/ -o /tmp/c.html; python3 -c " import re h=open('/tmp/c.html').read() m=re.search(r'Last synced:.*?

',h,re.S); print('lastSynced:', re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',m.group(0)) if m else 'NA') for p in ['Laptop','Phone','Tablet','Headphones','Watch']: m=re.search(re.escape(p)+r']*>\\\$(\d+)', h); print(f' {p:>10} -> \${m.group(1)}' if m else f' {p:>10} -> NA') "; echo "=== stop server ==="; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; echo done
cd /workspace; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig include ==="; grep -A4 '"include"' tsconfig.json; echo "=== .gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore
cd /workspace; echo "=== package.json diff ==="; git diff package.json; echo "=== tsconfig.json diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json
